# marcus: the world around the record

Everything here is fictional. It exists so the data has somewhere to come
from: routes explain repeated distances, the calendar explains gaps, people
explain context values. The generator draws from these constants, so the
record and this file agree by construction.

## Household and people

- York, England. Estate car, a two-up-two-down within running distance of
  the canal.
- Wife Claire. The phone-free-conversation count in `METRICS.md` is about
  her specifically.
- Alfie, 9, and Rosie, 6. Alfie sometimes runs parkrun with him on a
  Saturday (`context: family`, `with: Alfie` in sessions.jsonl - true, and
  logged proudly); Rosie does too, less often. Both came to watch him race
  in 2029, which the schema has no field for at all (see FINDINGS.md).
- No club, no training partner. He runs alone except for the family
  parkruns.

## Body and build

183 cm, about 78 kg across the record, drifting a little with the training
block and the season. The achilles is right-sided throughout.

## Transport and routine

Teaches at a secondary school; term dates are the whole shape of the
record's density. Term time: three runs a week (Tuesday track, Thursday
canal, Saturday parkrun or a long run). Holiday time: five, adding Monday
and Wednesday easy runs. Runs before the house wakes, most days -
"mornings out the door before the house woke" is one of the things he
counts privately (`METRICS.md`).

## Places

- **Grocery**: Tesco.
- **Gym**: none. Calf raises happen on a loaded barbell in the garage,
  which is where the `calf-raise-check` rows come from.
- **The cottage**: Whitby, for Easter, summer and part of the Christmas
  holidays. Holiday density (five runs a week) applies there too - the
  hidden 92 km week in August 2029 happens during the Whitby stretch.

## Route catalog

| Route | Distance | Shape | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| canal | 8.1 km | out and back | Thursday's run, term and holiday alike |
| park | 5.0 km | loop | Saturday parkrun outside any marathon block |
| long | 21.5 km | loop, extendable | the marathon-block long run; distance varies week to week against a 13-week ramp table, but the route label stays `long` |
| track | variable, ~8-10 km | intervals | Tuesday speed session |

The omitted 2029-08-07 run and the corrected 2029-08-09 run both claim
variants of the canal/long routes in note text; neither uses a route name
outside this catalog.

## Calendar and milestones

- 2028-01-03: record starts, spring term.
- Five marathons, the Ainsford Marathon (fictional), spring and autumn
  editions of the same race: 2028-04-09 (3:29), 2028-10-08 (3:21),
  2029-04-08 (3:17, PB), 2029-10-07 (DNF), 2030-04-07 (3:26).
- Achilles symptom notes from 2029-06-10; the episode is formally opened
  2029-11-04, after the DNF, and never resolves within the record.
- Easter, summer and Christmas holidays throughout 2028-2030, several spent
  at the Whitby cottage (see `HOLIDAYS` in `_gen/marcus.py` for exact
  windows).
- The hidden 92 km week: 2029-08-06 to 2029-08-12, inside the summer 2029
  holiday.
